entities.summary: Joonas Aleksi Rask is a Finnish professional ice hockey forward. He is currently playing with Kiekko-Espoo of the Liiga. He played 2 games in the National Hockey League with the Nashville Predators during the 2012–13 season. He is the younger brother of former goaltender Tuukka Rask.
